verdict.rationale: Dropbox's own Dash product lets users ask natural-language questions across their content and get 'clear answers'. Dropbox also advertises AI summarization and 'intelligent organization'. However, the evidence shows natural-language querying and summarizing, not operating the product itself (moving, sharing or managing files) by natural-language command. The organization claim appears only as a resource title and a forward-looking 'AI is coming' statement. Missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that perform file and folder actions (move, share, delete, set permissions), detail on how organize-with-AI works, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
